title: Unit Event — This Moment With You! — Episode2 Bubbling Hesitation

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need's debut single is taking off. Thanks to the impact of their VIRTUAL SINGER version, their label expresses hopes that the band will create VIRTUAL SINGER versions of all future songs. But Ichika seems hesitant...

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sorry about not allowing us to give a quick response. I know you're all really excited about this collaboration...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, don't apologize!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mr. Shindo even said that we shouldn't go ahead until we're all on the same page!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right. This collaboration isn't all that's involved. This matter is going to affect how we do things moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That being said...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Do you know why you're so bothered by this, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's the thing. I'm not really sure myself...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I keep getting this weird feeling.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I see...
I wish I could help you somehow...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In any case, let's take our time with this since we still have plenty of time to think.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Slow and steady!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Plus, we're having that party in SEKAI to mark our debut song becoming a big success♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, let's celebrate first, and then think this through!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
I forgot that we were having that party today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Since it's our big event, why don't we go buy some snacks for it?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sounds good.
Actually, if we don't, they're probably going to ask us why we didn't bring any.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe. Right.
I can see it already.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha♪ Then, let's go grab some snacks and head over to see Miku and the others!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay!
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are we all ready?

rows.Speaker: Rin & Saki
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ready...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, here's to your debut song becoming a big hit... Raise your glasses!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Congratulations, girls.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: How awesome is it that your very first song went so viral?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: To be fair, Miku's version is the one that went viral.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, I'm glad that so many people decided to listen to our performance...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too! A bunch of people even posted videos of themselves singing our song after listening to the Miku version!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Remember the ones who said it was really fun to sing because the music and our performance were so good? That made me super happy!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Me too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You and Ichika really did come up with a wonderful song, Saki. Thank you both for putting so much effort into it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. You and Shiho looked so cool while playing it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thanks.
I guess all our pair practice paid off.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, is anyone else seeing these sodas for the first time?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, I was gonna ask the same thing!
What's with all these flavors?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, about those. The company that makes them asked us to appear in one of their commercials!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? One of their commercials?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, which is why we thought we could try some of their products together.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Huh...
Still, this is a huge lineup.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I like all these flavors, but I recommend the melon soda the most♪ Making ice cream floats with this is always fun because it ends up tasting just like the ones you can get at cafes and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow, that sounds delicious!
I wanna make that☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Still, it's incredible how you received this sort of offer just following the release of your debut song.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A part of me feels that things are going a little too well for us at the moment. Also, we haven't actually agreed to take their offer yet.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, why not?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Because I'm still unsure...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You are?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Any reason as to why?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Any reason? I'm still having trouble putting it into words...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They want Leo/need to make a VIRTUAL SINGER version of each song you produce moving forward...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I don't have a problem with you singing instead of me, Miku. We've already been having you sing our songs up until now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Having you sing songs before they're finalized has been really helpful too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But a part of me feels uncomfortable with the idea of making you this integral part of our promotional strategy...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You've meant quite a lot to Ichika since she was little, so I don't think she wants to treat you unfairly in any way...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're also the reason why we decided to form our band in elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: In elementary school...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Ichika, what were you like back then?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? M-Me...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, it's never really come up before.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
But now I'm curious.
And talking about it could provide you with a hint to solving this problem, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A hint...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. Standing still like this is only going to cause everyone else around me trouble...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This is going to be a little embarrassing for me, but...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I discovered Miku when I was in fifth grade. I remember going to the park with my family and...
